longs.thesis: Record Q3 revenue $13.38B (+45% YoY), data-center revenue $8.55B (+97% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $2.09 beating estimates; Q4 revenue guided to ~$17B (+/-3%). Gapping up off a beat-and-raise, leading the chip rebound.
Q3 revenue $3.66B (+58.5% YoY, fastest since its IPO), above its $3.3B guide; Q4 guided to $3.9-4.0B. Earnings gap higher on its strongest growth print since listing.
Solar group bid as election results were read as friendlier to clean energy. Sharp gap up with the solar theme leading this morning.

Sale of its LPG carrier Dream Arrax to Robin Energy for $18M, a deal that previously drove a 138% surge on heavy volume. Low-float momentum name whipping between the low-$12s and near-$14 premarket - high volatility.

shorts.thesis: Fiscal 2027 revenue guided down 14.3-17.9% and EPS down 26-30%, citing a T-Mobile contract dispute that could end in termination; Oppenheimer downgraded to Perform. Gap-down toward its lowest since early 2013.
Weak December-quarter guidance reported alongside AMD/Arista after the close. Earnings gap-down against a strong chip tape - relative weakness.
Democratic midterm sweep. Election-driven gap-down, no earnings catalyst behind it.
